name: poster_craft
description: Poster V3 playbook: brief → thesis → composition → tokens → paint → observe → review → subtraction
when_to_use: Poster / 海报 / roll-up / 易拉宝 / decorative print / decorative event visual — illustrated or photo hero with title groups (not SaaS UI chrome, not multi-section website)
prompt_negative: No unjustified purple-blue glass postcard defaults. No inventing logos/prices/QR. Prefer overlay type over baked titles. Complex atmosphere → image_gen, not crude shape piles.
